AfterSideTurnEnd.issue: SLOT. AbstractModel.AfterSideTurnEnd is dispatched by Hook.AfterTurnEnd (Hook.cs:1267-1292), called ONCE for the whole enemy side (CombatManager.cs:1256) after every enemy has moved; the sim implements it with the PER-ENEMY slot on_enemy_turn_end (combat.py:341), which fires immediately after each enemy's own move. The sim HAS the side-scoped slot and does not use it here: on_enemy_side_end (combat.py:345). turn_structure gap G5 (the enemy side is per-enemy in the sim, per-side in the game) is the owning record and carries the identical `gap` verdict; not re-verdicted here per binding rule 3. DORMANT, and the dormancy is EXECUTED rather than asserted -- see `py audit/tools/power_slot_probes.py rosters` and `enemy-hook-order`. Executed: THIEVING_HOPPER_WEAK is a solo encounter (n=1, order=['ThievingHopper'], `py audit/tools/power_slot_probes.py rosters`), so the per-creature slot and the side slot coincide.
